lastCompletedStory.title: Parse the stream-json event vocabulary and persist an append-only per-dispatch log

nextStoryContext: headless-stream.ts exports classifyHeadlessStreamLine(line: string): HeadlessStreamEvent, a discriminated union keyed by `kind`: 'system' (carries subtype, e.g. 'init'), 'rate_limit_event', 'assistant', 'user', 'result' (carries totalCostUsd read from total_cost_usd, undefined when absent/non-numeric), 'stream_event' (its own explicit branch, deliberately ignored, GOTCHA H), and 'malformed' (carries a reason: 'invalid-json' | 'not-an-object' | 'unrecognized-type', raw preserved where available). Never throws. headless-log.ts exports headlessDispatchLogPath(claudeDir, uuid) and openHeadlessDispatchLog(claudeDir, uuid) -> { path, appendLine(line) }: appendLine does appendFileSync(path, line + '\n') against a real fs path, creating claudeDir via mkdirSync if needed. Opening a second writer against the same uuid is safe (append-only, never truncates) -- this is the exact shape US-003's headless-dispatch.ts needs to consume the NDJSON stdout stream line-by-line through classifyHeadlessStreamLine and append every raw line verbatim through openHeadlessDispatchLog(claudeDir, dispatchUuid).appendLine, then resolve the dispatch outcome from the LAST 'result' event's totalCostUsd. Log files live at .claude/cam-headless-dispatch-<uuid>.jsonl, gitignored via a new glob entry added to both .gitignore and templates/.gitignore (embed-vendor re-run, embed-vendor:check clean). Precedent worth knowing: src/supervisor/events.ts's makeFileEventLogger is the existing appendFileSync-based file-logger precedent this module's writer mirrors; src/supervisor/early-death.ts's extractLastAssistantEntry is the existing 'skip malformed JSON, never throw' precedent this module's classifier mirrors.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Confirms stream-json is NDJSON with the last line a 'result' message carrying cost + session metadata (matches total_cost_usd read here). Confirms system/init reports session metadata as (normally) the first event. Confirms stream_event token-level deltas are emitted ONLY under --include-partial-messages, which headless-argv.ts (US-001) never passes -- matches this story's deliberate, explicit, always-ignored stream_event branch (GOTCHA H). The doc page does not itself enumerate rate_limit_event or assistant/user as a vocabulary list; that exact 5-member vocabulary (system/init, rate_limit_event, assistant, user, result) is the empirically MEASURED set from the 2026-08-08 live billing measurement recorded in ADR-0059 and CONTEXT.md's 'stream-json' glossary entry, which this story's notes name as GOTCHA I and which this implementation classifies verbatim.
